title: Royal Ballistix — Beach Siege
description: Radial ball-deflection survival game for 2–10 contestants. One local player can defend a gate with movement, Magnet, Pulse and Run while AI bots fill remaining seats; arena size is adjustable and phone/network transport is not yet integrated.
